title_tag: 7 Best Yacht Tours in Dubai (2026): Prices Compared
meta_description: 7 shared yacht tours in Dubai Marina and Dubai Harbour compared on price, length, BBQ, drinks, swim stops and sunset times. From €16 per person.
h1: 7 Best Yacht Tours in Dubai Marina (2026)
h1_main: 7 Best Yacht Tours in Dubai Marina in 2026
author_role: 7 shared yacht tours compared on price, cruise length, BBQ, drinks, swim stop and departure point
lead: For most people the best yacht tour in Dubai is the Xclusive Yachts cruise from Dubai Marina, from €23: you board inside the Marina, the guide speaks English, French or German, and the 2-hour and 3-hour options add a BBQ (or breakfast in the morning) and sail on to Burj Al Arab. For the same coastline from Dubai Harbour with soft drinks included, Sky Walker starts at €20.

The yachts look alike in the photos. What decides your evening is the option you tick: the 1-hour cruises loop the Marina, Ain Dubai and JBR with drinks only, while food and Burj Al Arab come with the 2-hour options. Only two of the seven offer a swim stop, and only one, the €80 Ride and Slide, lists alcohol as included.
Below are 7 shared yacht tours from €16 to €85 per person, ranked, with a table comparing length, food, drinks, swim stop, departure point and sunset times.

review: This is the default Dubai yacht tour for a reason. From €23 you board a 65-foot-plus yacht inside Dubai Marina at the Xclusive Yachts point on Marina Level, Al Majara, after a wait in a lounge with free Wi-Fi. It has more guest reviews than any other yacht tour here and still averages 4.7.

The option you choose decides what you get. The 1-hour cruise circles the Marina, Ain Dubai, JBR and Dubai Harbour with water and tropical drinks only. The 2-hour and 3-hour options go on past the Palm and Atlantis to Burj Al Arab and add BBQ food, or a light breakfast if you sail in the morning. Pick a sunset departure on the longer options for the best light.

Against Sky Walker from Dubai Harbour, this one wins on languages (live guide in English, French or German) and on boarding right in the Marina. It loses on drinks: Sky Walker includes soft drinks and juices on every option, while here alcohol is a paid extra and there is no swimming at all. Dress code is smart casual, no bikinis and no shoes on board.

review: Most sightseeing yacht tours on this page ban swimwear. This one is the opposite: the Ride and Slide cruise sails from Dubai Harbour to a sheltered anchorage beneath Palm Jumeirah, blows up an inflatable slide off the top deck and sea loungers, and hands out a paddle board and snorkelling gear.

It is also the only yacht tour here that lists alcohol as included: unlimited house drinks, cocktails and soft drinks, plus a BBQ lunch (burgers, hot dogs, chicken skewers, lamb koftas and vegetarian skewers, fruit and muffins). At €80 for 3 hours it works out at about €27 per hour, with no food or drinks to buy on board.

Do not book it for sightseeing: the scenic part is a short sail past the Marina and Marina Beach before the yacht parks for the afternoon. Bring swimwear, a towel and goggles. If you want more action on the water, pair it with a jet ski tour on another day, or see the Dubai scuba diving options for proper underwater time.

guide.h2: Which Yacht Tour Should You Book?
guide.html:
• First yacht tour, staying in Dubai Marina: Xclusive Yachts from the Marina. Take the 2-hour sunset option for the BBQ and Burj Al Arab.
  • Best food for the money: Sky Walker on a 2-hour or 3-hour Burj Al Arab option, with live BBQ and soft drinks included. Avoid the 1-hour and Atlantis options if you want to eat.
  • Sunset yacht in Dubai: the 17:00 departure of the 360 Adventures sunset tour, with light bites and a sunset photo stop when the Burj Al Arab route is sailed.
  • You want to swim, or drinks included: Ride and Slide, the only tour with an open bar, a BBQ lunch and a yacht slide.
  • Cheapest, one hour, evening lights: Splash Tours from €16 in Dubai Marina.
  • Staying near Dubai Harbour, Bluewaters or the Palm: Sky Walker or the Xclusive Yachts Harbour tour.
  • Half a day on the water: the 3–5 hour cruise if you accept a new listing, otherwise Ride and Slide.
  • Dinner and a show on board: that is a different product; see our Dubai dinner cruise comparison.

guide.h2: Practical Tips: Departure Point, Best Time and What Costs Extra
guide.html:
Dubai Marina or Dubai Harbour?

Three tours board inside Dubai Marina (Xclusive Yachts at Al Majara, Splash Tours behind the Al Rahim Mosque on Al Seba Street, and the Smile cruise once its harbour is confirmed). They suit anyone staying in the Marina or JBR, and the first minutes of the cruise are among the towers. Three more leave from Dubai Harbour (Sky Walker, Ride and Slide and the Xclusive Yachts Harbour tour). Parking at the Sky Walker club costs AED 10 per hour; none of the tours lists hotel pickup as included. If you have not booked a room yet, our Dubai Marina hotel guide compares where to stay in the Marina.

Best time to go

For light and views, go at sunset: the 17:00 two-hour slot on the 360 Adventures tour or a sunset departure on the Xclusive Yachts 2-hour option. For the lit-up skyline, the 20:00 BBQ dinner slot on the 360 Adventures tour sails after dark. Morning cruises on Xclusive Yachts come with breakfast.

What to wear and bring

Shoes come off on board on most of these yachts. On the sightseeing tours the dress code is smart casual, no bikinis and no swimwear; only the Ride and Slide and the 3–5 hour cruise expect swimwear. Bring a passport or ID card (a copy is accepted on some tours), sunglasses and sunscreen for the upper deck, and arrive 20 to 30 minutes early: Sky Walker departures leave on the minute and cannot be delayed.

What costs extra

On #1, #2, #3 and #6 alcohol is sold on board; only the Ride and Slide lists it as included. Food depends on the option, not the tour: BBQ is on the 2-hour and 3-hour options of #1, #2 and #6, and none of the 1-hour cruises includes food. None of these tours includes jet skis; book them separately through our jet ski comparison. For a faster ride past the Palm, Atlantis and Burj Al Arab, a speedboat tour is the alternative; see our Dubai boat tours guide. And for the same coastline from the air, there are helicopter tours.

Shared tour or private yacht?

Everything on this page is a shared yacht tour priced per person, so you sail with other guests on a fixed route. Private charters are priced per yacht for your group alone and are a separate purchase; they are not compared here.

faqs.q: How much is a yacht tour in Dubai?
faqs.a: Shared yacht tours start at €16 per person for one hour (Splash Tours in Dubai Marina) and €19 to €23 for the big operators' entry options. Longer cruises with BBQ cost more depending on the option, and the all-inclusive 3-hour Ride and Slide with open bar and BBQ lunch is €80. A 3 to 5-hour cruise with snacks starts at €85.

faqs.q: What is the best yacht tour in Dubai Marina?
faqs.a: The Xclusive Yachts tour from Dubai Marina for most people: from €23, it boards inside the Marina, has a live guide in English, French or German, and the 2-hour and 3-hour options add BBQ or breakfast and go to Burj Al Arab. For more included drinks, Sky Walker from Dubai Harbour starts at €20 with soft drinks and juices.

faqs.q: Is BBQ included on Dubai yacht tours?
faqs.a: Only on certain options. Xclusive Yachts and Sky Walker serve BBQ on their 2-hour and 3-hour options, the Xclusive Yachts Harbour tour on its 2-hour option, and the 360 Adventures sunset tour serves food on every slot (BBQ dinner at 20:00). The Ride and Slide includes a BBQ lunch. One-hour cruises do not include food.

faqs.q: Can you swim on a yacht tour in Dubai?
faqs.a: On most sightseeing yacht tours, no: there is no swim time and swimwear is not allowed. The Ride and Slide cruise anchors in a sheltered zone beneath Palm Jumeirah with a yacht slide, paddle board and snorkel gear, and the 3–5 hour Smile cruise may stop for a swim depending on the sea.

faqs.q: Are drinks included on a Dubai yacht cruise?
faqs.a: Soft drinks or water are included on all seven tours here, and four of them sell alcohol on board. The only one that lists alcohol as included is the Ride and Slide, with unlimited house drinks, cocktails and soft drinks.

faqs.q: What is the best sunset yacht tour in Dubai?
faqs.a: The 17:00 two-hour departure of the 360 Adventures sunset yacht tour, from €19 with light bites and soft drinks, and a sunset photo stop when the Burj Al Arab route is sailed. Xclusive Yachts also runs sunset cruises with BBQ on its longer options.

faqs.q: Is a yacht tour or a dinner cruise better in Dubai?
faqs.a: A yacht tour is shorter, cheaper and about the views and photos, with snacks or BBQ at most. A dinner cruise is built around a buffet or set menu and often live entertainment. If dinner is the point, compare the options in our Dubai dinner cruise guide.

methodology: We compared 7 bookable shared yacht tours departing from Dubai Marina and Dubai Harbour, from 1-hour skyline loops to 5-hour cruises. Each was scored on per-person price and price per hour, cruise length, what food and drinks are really included on each option, swim stop, departure point, route and time of day. Prices are live listing from-prices for a normal date; ratings come from verified guest reviews. Dinner cruises and private charters are covered separately.
